Diagnosis: Conflicting position constraints: both 'reach_distance' and 'freeze_position' were used in one Constraints list, violating the rule of only a single position operator per subtask. The freeze_position on manipulator_high_effort overlapped with reach_distance, causing the error.
Reasoning: Success in this subtask is defined as: (1) The gripper must remain open throughout the approach, which is represented by the open_gripper constraint. (2) The tool orientation (panda_fingertip) must remain unchanged from its initial orientation, so freeze_orientation is used. (3) Completion occurs if either (a) the end-effector (panda_fingertip) comes within 1 cm of the cube_1 center, or (b) effort/contact feedback (manipulator_high_effort) indicates initial contact. Thus, a single position operator is needed for the approach ('reach_distance' at the required tolerance), and manipulator_high_effort is used as an alternative stopping condition—these must be combined by logic 'or' in a single constraint. Only a single position op is allowed, so freeze_position on manipulator_high_effort is removed; contact as a stopping event is handled via the condition field instead.
